name: Warm Blueberry Streusel Cake with Vanilla Ice Cream (Night 2)
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Magic · Rapunzel's Royal Table (Snuggly Duckling Night 2)
whyItWorks: Unlike raspberries or blackberries, baked blueberries have soft skins and tiny undetectable seeds, over a tender butter streusel cake.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Confirm no nuts are in the streusel crumble and pair with a Lactaid for the vanilla ice cream.
